# V_eta migration coverage ledger

*Generated by `tools/coverage.py` -- do NOT hand-edit; re-run after a schema or migrator change. One row per did_v1 SOURCE class, from BOTH v1 writers: the NDI production templates (read from NDI-matlab `origin/main`, not a lagging feature branch) AND the vhlab app/calculator classes that appear in real corpora but ship no NDI template (footprint = a bespoke migrator that consumes them). Post-v1 DID intermediate classes (zarr, directory, the `*_observation` leaves, ...) are V_eta TARGETS, not v1 sources, and are excluded. Each row shows the V_eta document class(es) the v1 class MIGRATES INTO (from the curated `V_eta_migration_targets.json`), its disposition, and its writer.*

**115 v1 source classes** (104 NDI/main + 11 vhlab app) | by V_eta disposition: UNMAPPED (needs a V_eta home)=2, consumed by migrator (no tombstone)=30, dissolved → subject=1, in_progress=6, persist=1, retire=73, test/demo fixture (non-production)=2 | 98 have a bespoke migrator | ⚠ 2 UNMAPPED (no V_eta class, no migrator).

**No-target census.** DENOMINATOR: 115 rows inspected; 9 name no target class of any kind. Across ALL 115 rows the recorded no-target dispositions are **4 dissolved** (signed, final -- note a dissolution is a fact about the DECISION, so a row can carry one while its migrator still emits the class today), **1 DISPUTED**, **2 signed passthroughs** whose decided target is the class itself, and **3 with NO TARGET AND NO DISSOLUTION RECORDED** (`demoNDISeries`, `demoNDISeriesMixed`, `imageStack_parameters`). Only the last is a missing record; the blank rows not otherwise accounted for are test/demo scaffolding or pre-V_zeta dissolutions, already labelled in the disposition column. A blank cell is no longer expressible: a row with no target must carry a transcribed sign-off saying so, or it renders as a gap.

**How much is built.** DENOMINATOR: 115 of 115 row(s) classified, 0 UNCLASSIFIABLE. **102 of 115 v1 source classes have something in the migration that CONSUMES them; 13 do not.** That rung has an answer on every row -- 0 unmeasured -- which is why it leads. Governance is NOT part of this ladder: whether a sign-off can be found for a class is reported in its own column and never caps a build stage.

**Completion ladder.** A class lands on EXACTLY ONE stage -- the highest rung for which every rung below it is satisfied -- so a rung that is `no` or `not measured` stops the climb even when a higher one holds. The stage is DERIVED from fields on the row; there is no list to hand-set. `not measured` is not `no`. Rungs 1 and 2 do not imply each other, so their order is a tie broken toward the FULLY MEASURED one -- putting the unread rung first would cap 49 rows below a fact this tool knows for certain.

| stage | what it means | classes AT this stage | rung satisfied on its own | yes / no / n/a / not measured |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 0 | source identified | 13 | 115 (by construction) | — |
| 1 | a migrator CONSUMES it | 37 | 102 | 102 / 13 / 0 / 0 |
| 2 | its decided target classes EXIST in the build | 13 | 66 | 66 / 0 / 4 / 45 |
| 3 | the migrator emits THE DECIDED targets | 52 | 50 | 50 / 16 / 4 / 45 |
| 4 | CORPUS-PROVEN | 0 | 0 | 0 / 0 / 0 / 115 |

**Capped, or untouched? DENOMINATOR: 115 classified row(s).** 3 are CAPPED -- a rung above their stage is satisfied while a lower one is unread or unmet -- and **8 are GENUINELY UNTOUCHED: no rung is satisfied at all** (`animalsubject`, `base`, `calculator`, `demoNDISeries`, `demoNDISeriesMixed`, `imageCollection`, `imageStack_parameters`, `mock`). A further 2 have nothing built while the rungs above them are `n/a` by a SIGNED DISSOLUTION (`stimulus_response`, `stimulus_response_scalar_parameters`) -- counted apart, because a settled class and an unexamined one must never be one figure. The untouched number is the honest floor. `highest rung satisfied on its own` is NOT a stage and must never be quoted as one; it exists so a capped row can say which rung holds above its cap.

**49 of 115 rows record NO TARGET CLASS**, which makes rungs 2 and 3 unreadable for them: `decided_targets` is empty, so rung 2 has nothing to look for in the built set and rung 3 has nothing to check an emission against. NOT evidence that no target exists. The signature join moves **0** of them, and that zero is structural, not a shortfall -- a decision citation names a decision LINE, not a per-class target list. The join can say a class is decided; it cannot say WHAT it becomes. Naming a target from it would be inventing one.

**Stage 4 (CORPUS-PROVEN) is NOT MEASURED on all 115 rows** -- no corpus report root was supplied (pass --corpus-reports DIR or set V_ETA_CORPUS_REPORTS). It is not `no` and it is not skipped: "no corpus proved it" and "nobody looked" are different facts, and this container has no MATLAB and cannot download run artifacts. It is the only honest "done" measure this ledger has. WHAT WOULD LIGHT IT UP: a DID-matlab corpus run's `<corpus>-summary.json` reports reachable from this repo -- pass --corpus-reports DIR or set V_ETA_CORPUS_REPORTS. Each report must carry `source_census.by_class` (per v1 SOURCE class) plus `quarantine_count`, `fragment_count`, `reference_integrity.orphan_count` and `silent_loss.empty_required_dependency`.

**Anomalies: 3 across 3 class(es).** A rung satisfied above the stage a class reached. Not smoothed away and not promoted -- `over_failed` (3) means a lower rung has POSITIVE evidence against it, a real contradiction; `over_unmeasured` (0) means evidence exists above a hole in the record, which is a transcription job and not a build job. CONTRADICTIONS: `ensemble` (stage 2), `projectvar` (stage 2), `stimulus_parameter_table` (stage 2).

**12 row(s) claim a decision this tool cannot find** -- `V_eta_migration_targets.json` gives them `decided_targets`, which its own header calls "a signed decision no migrator implements yet", but no decision line is quoted and checked for them and the class cites none. This caps NOTHING (the completion ladder no longer reads governance); it is a hole in the RECORD: `contrast_tuning`, `contrast_tuning_calc`, `orientation_direction_tuning`, `spatial_frequency_tuning`, `spatial_frequency_tuning_calc`, `speed_tuning`, `speed_tuning_calc`, `stimulus_tuningcurve`, `temporal_frequency_tuning`, `temporal_frequency_tuning_calc`, `treatment_drug`, `virus_injection`.

**Decisions -- is each class DECIDED? A FLAG, NOT A STAGE, and never added to one.** DENOMINATOR: 115 row(s) classified. **70 decided** (9 checked transcription on the row, 61 cited by the class), **1 DISPUTED** (the record states two incompatible dispositions), **0 citing a decision line that does not resolve**, **44 proposed (not decided)** -- no decision line is cited for the class (`tools/decision_citations.py`). A class is decided only when it cites a `TEAM-SIGN-OFF [tag]` line or a `Decided by <team member>, <date> [<tag>]:` line that exists.

**The citation join, measured.** DENOMINATOR: 115 row(s) inspected; 71 carry a citation that resolves (71 on v1_class). It matches the row's OWN identity (its v1 name or its V_eta class, EXACTLY, with no normalisation), never what its migrator emits.

| rows with no resolved citation | cause |
|---:|---|
| 0 | the class cites a decision line that does not resolve |
| 1 | no citation names this class; a class it EMITS cites a decision |
| 4 | no citation names this class, and the row has no V_eta class and no target either |
| 39 | no decision citation names this class |

**Where the decision lines are. DENOMINATOR: 63 document(s) read (3 generated artifact(s) excluded, carrying 0 marker(s) between them -- a generated file quotes decisions, it does not hold them); 205 decision line(s) accepted (89 Decided by, 116 TEAM-SIGN-OFF), 2 rejected; 41 cited by a class, 164 cited by none. 81 citation(s) from 73 class(es); 0 do not resolve.**

**164 decision line(s) are cited by no class.** Most decide something that is not one class's disposition (a tenet, a naming rule, a field); if one does decide a class, that class should cite it: sync configuration amendment 1. It was NOT: the signed amendment of that date says 'IS NOT RE-ARMED YET', and resolveValidIntervals.m at 775353d (2026-08-13, the head of both DID-matlab V_eta branches) is still 'DORMANT BY DECISION -- census only; emits nothing', its preserved code being the rejected 1->N shape. THE SIGNED TARGET (TEAM-SIGN-OFF [logical_observation amendment 1], V_eta_logical_observation_plan.md, 2026-08-18): the leaf is `observation + time`, NOT `logical_observation` (retired, #73 item 52), and THE INTERVAL TIMES ARE THE VALUE. One statement per source document carrying an N x 2 array of `time` cells keyed [interval (a bare regular index), endpoint (labels `start`, `end`)], so the pairing is DECLARED rather than positional (T14). WHY THE BOOLEAN ARRAY WAS WITHDRAWN: the v1 class declares four fields (timeref_structt0, t0, timeref_structt1, t1) and NOT ONE IS A BOOLEAN, so a boolean array would have been INVENTED on every migrated document, and for a list of VALID intervals every element of it is true by construction. Each statement is anchored by a `relative_time_reference` via `time_reference_id` (start = t0, duration = t1 - t0, clock de-encoded from clocktypestring), whose `referent_id` names the minted `epoch` DOCUMENT. A batch pass and not a migrator for the same structural reason as resolveSessionAnchors: that document's id exists only after did2.convert.epochMint has minted it corpus-wide, and a single-document migrator holds an epoch STRING it cannot map to a document id. ⚠ ADDS, NEVER REMOVES. The source document is KEPT under its v1 tombstone (nothing required, `element_id` optional), so a passthrough cannot trip mustBeNonEmpty or undeclaredField. SIGNED: TEAM-SIGN-OFF [logical_observation] 2026-08-12 plus TEAM-SIGN-OFF [logical_observation amendment 1] 2026-08-18, which supersedes the LEAF AND THE VALUE only -- the 2026-08-12 reasoning about `variable` carrying the semantic, about `sequence` being deleted, about transitive inheritance and about the three reading states all stand. `logical_observation` was left with NO CONSUMER (valid_interval was its only one) and is RETIRED, #73 item 52 (2026-09-25); `logical` stays, like every value. `sequence` is DELETED: v1's array-append order is invisible to its only consumer (tuning_response.m:253-256 indexes identifyvalidintervals's RETURN VALUE, and markgarbage.m:178-204 accumulates every row through a set union without indexing by position).
